description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the training yard at its grandest: a large square of packed brown earth inside tall crenellated grey stone walls with two small corner towers and a red banner, six straw training dummies, a sparring ring of rope on wooden posts, long racks of blunt swords, spears, axes and shields, straw archery targets along the wall, a covered wooden stand with a shingle roof over a stone bench, nobody on the yard, no people and no figures

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
